findings.legal_reasoning: The DPDP Act requires that any request for consent to process personal data be accompanied by a notice that includes the purpose of the processing (Section 5(1)). The evidence supplied (E007) shows that the register view writes the user’s email, display name and marketing opt‑in to the UserProfile model and references consent, but it does not demonstrate that the user was informed of the specific purpose (i.e., providing profile and account services) at the time of consent. Therefore, the evidence does not establish compliance with the purpose‑limitation requirement as mandated by the Act.
